dedupe_keys.name: norwegian municipal wastewater facilities 50 p e and above with discharge parameters and arctic classification

description: This data product compiles 2,663 registered municipal wastewater facilities in Norway with a design capacity of at least 50 person-equivalents from public data of the Norwegian Environment Agency, retrieved on 30 September 2025, translated to English and harmonised. Attributes include design capacity, treatment principle and process class, recipient category, selected annual discharges from Norske utslipp (BOD5, COD, suspended solids, total nitrogen and total phosphorus in tonnes a year), monitoring requirements, and municipal, county and authority identifiers; each facility is also linked to permafrost zones and the AMAP Arctic boundary. It is published by SINTEF on data.sintef.no as a GeoPackage and a CSV with a PDF of the R processing code and a DOI, under open terms compatible with the NLOD and CC BY 4.0 source licences. Caveats: coverage is national and discharges are only the selected parameters, and the register reflects one retrieval date. Simulation uses: small and large treatment plants for capacity planning, Arctic and permafrost hazard exposure and climate adaptation of wastewater systems. Related records: the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive plant data (data-uwwtd-treatment-plants) and the SFI European plant database (data-sfi-municipal-wwtp-database-europe).
